Lie down, lie down, love Henry Lee and stay with me this night[/tab]
[tab][ch]Am[/ch]               [ch]F[/ch]                    [ch]Em[/ch]
You will have my candle and coal, my fire's burnin' bright[/tab]
[tab]                  [ch]Am[/ch]
My fire's burnin' bright[/tab]
 
[tab]   [ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]      [ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]       [ch]Am[/ch]       [ch]Em[/ch]         [ch]F[/ch]
I won't lie down, I can't lie down, and stay all night with thee[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]Am[/ch]             [ch]F[/ch]                  [ch]Em[/ch]
There's a lady ten times fairer than you in Barnard's Hall for me[/tab]

[tab]      [ch]Am[/ch]     [ch]Em[/ch]        [ch]Am[/ch]     [ch]Em[/ch]      [ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]       [ch]F[/ch]
He's leanin' o'er her soft pillow to give her a kiss so sweet[/tab]
[tab]         [ch]Am[/ch]                    [ch]F[/ch]                    [ch]Em[/ch]
But her little pen knife held keen and sharp, she's wounded him full deep[/tab]
[tab]                       [ch]Am[/ch]
She's wounded him full deep[/tab]

[tab]     [ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch]      [ch]Am[/ch]      [ch]Em[/ch]       [ch]Am[/ch]     [ch]Em[/ch]      [ch]F[/ch]
Oh I will lie down, I must lie down, I welcome it said he[/tab]

There's no lady in Barnard's Hall that I love better than thee[/tab]
[tab]                         [ch]Am[/ch]

[tab]    [ch]Am[/ch]                 [ch]F[/ch]                  [ch]Em[/ch]
She threw him down a cold dark well some fifty fathoms deep[/tab]
[tab]                     [ch]Am[/ch]
A full fifty fathoms deep[/tab]

[tab]     [ch]Am[/ch]       [ch]Em[/ch]        [ch]Am[/ch]            [ch]Em[/ch]        [ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Em[/ch]      [ch]F[/ch]
Lie down, lie down, you pretty little bird, lie down along my knee[/tab]

[tab]                              [ch]Am[/ch]

[tab][ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Em[/ch]        [ch]Am[/ch]      [ch]Em[/ch]        [ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Em[/ch]       [ch]F[/ch]
